summary.headline: Astrological Topics and Kamateros’s Poem
summary.text: Catalog entries 463–483 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering seasonal tetrarchs, overseers, lunar nodes and planetary conjunctions, eclipses, surgery, purgations, phlebotomy, signs, marriage, death, moving house, triplicities, planetary benefactions, and Kamateros’s poem on the zodiacal circle. Cross-references cite codices 6 and 8 and other folios.
